title: Registrations open for the Innovation Fund 2026 Info Days
summary: CINEA has opened registration for four online Info Days on the Innovation Fund 2026 calls and auctions. The joint session on the Net-Zero Technologies call (€3.3 billion) and the new Maritime call (€200 million) takes place on 15 December 2026; other sessions on 9–10 December cover the hydrogen and heat auctions and the SME call.
why_it_matters: The Net-Zero Technologies call is the main EU grant route that Nordic-Baltic capture, transport and storage projects have used, so its timeline shapes the project pipeline that network models must assume.
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
